note: The level-up's notice (AR12, B). One plate on the left, its top left at `place` on the screen. Every place is in points from the plate's own top left (its body's box, not its image's: the image reaches 16 past it on every side). An image's `at` is its own top left, and it's shown at its `points`.

place.why: the lead's card's left edge, under the readout's row (its foot at 230) and over the thumbstick (its top at 289)

plate.width: 83.8 + the wider of the name at 16 points and "LEVEL UP" at 11
plate.leans: its ends lean `lean` across per down: the top edge starts tall * lean to the right of the foot's

number.note: centred on the block; its size by its count of digits

words.note: `at` is a word's left end and its capitals' top

motion.note: DESIGN, as the clip shows it (levelup_notice_clip.mp4); untried in Studio. Seconds.

slideIn.start: wholly off the screen's left edge, its glow with it

number.note: it falls from `fromSize` times its size to `squash` (quadratic in), fading in over the fall's first third, then settles to 1 (quadratic out)

flash.note: its strength falls to nothing, quadratic out

knock.note: the whole notice, to the right and back, at the landing

sheen.travel: its middle from 30 points left of the plate to 30 past its far end, along the foot; the band's middle at the foot is 27 from its image's left
sheen.note: in the clip it shows only on the plate's own shape. With a box for a clip it would show past the leaning ends: fade it in over its first 26 points on the plate and out over its last 26, or clip it by the plate's image

motion.reducedMotion: it fades in at its place with the number set, no fall, flash, knock or sheen, and fades out

LevelUpPlate.use: the whole plate: shadow, glow, body, block, rim. Under the words. Its width is `plate.width`

LevelUpFlash.use: the block in white, over the plate and under the number: the flash as the number lands

LevelUpSheen.use: the sheen: over the plate and under the words, moved across once after the landing
